risk_note: RV2 (platform idempotency; no migration, no contract change). D10-1099 Q-6 (B1-20c plan §8.1): executeInTransaction stores the full code 0 / 3xxxx response in idempotency_keys.response for 30 days; POST /v1/auth/merge's success response carries the target account's access / refresh tokens and is never replayed (the source session is revoked, a same-key retry stops at 10002), so plain tokens would sit in the database against 04 §3.2 「token 只存哈希」. Added an optional third argument { archive } (contract in platform/idempotency/archive.ts): for a stored result, archive gets a fresh copy of the response and returns the body to store; the caller still gets the original response. archive throwing rethrows and rolls back; an invalid return or a changed code is invalid_result with a full rollback; results that are not stored and same-key replays never call archive; StoredRejection 3xxxx also goes through it. Without the argument every stored column and the replay are unchanged (27 unit tests in platform/idempotency). Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21).
